_why: D32 SPEC section 5 (operator APPROVED 2026-11-04 ~18:15 ET): for single-stock positions above a size threshold with an earnings or known event window, the CIO may suggest a protective put or a collar with cost and floor. Advisory only: the system never places, sizes, stops or cancels an order (AGENTS.md rule 1, MBI_BEHAVIOR = 0). Values are config, not hard-coded, so the operator can tune the threshold and the window without a code change.

notes.threshold: A position at or above this share of the book is worth hedging; below it the premium is not worth the commission.
notes.event_window: The same 10-before/2-after shape the earnings vertical registry uses; days_to_event is negative after the event.
notes.floor: When the position carries a broker stop, the put strike targets the stop (the position is already defended there). Otherwise the strike targets spot minus the configured percent.
notes.cost: With a usable supplied option chain, cost_per_contract_usd is the quoted ask times the standard 100-share multiplier, per contract. With no chain, the LABELED estimate is estimated_cost_pct_of_position of the value of 100 reference shares at reference_price, and cost_is_estimate is true. No holding-wide premium or selected contract quantity is implied. A quoted floor_price is reported only when a real put strike was chosen.
notes.cost_gate: A premium per standard contract above max_cost_pct_of_position of the value of 100 reference shares is refused (cost_exceeds_position_value). The comparison uses the same per-contract reference basis as the quoted premium or estimate; it is not an aggregate holding-cost limit.
notes.floor_distance: The chosen strike is compared to the floor the basis names. More than max_floor_distance_pct_of_target away and the suggestion carries floor_target, floor_distance, floor_target_relation, floor_strike_far_from_target and a floor_warning: a 150 put under a 235 broker stop does not defend the stop.
notes.floor_after_cost: floor_per_covered_share_after_premium is the quoted put strike less premium per covered share of a standard contract. Premium at or above the strike leaves that field null, with floor_after_premium_note explaining why. position_floor_after_cost is always null; no position-wide protected level is computed.
notes.never_placed: No configuration value can make this lane place, size or cancel anything; the module has no broker import path and every suggestion carries placed_by_system: false.
notes.partial_coverage: coverage_status is not_selected and coverage_note explains that holding coverage has not been selected. No contract count, covered/uncovered share count or worst-case-per-share figure is produced by design. Unit economics and a per-covered-share put floor never guarantee protection of the holding.
